authorization_note: For the current B4 training-system validation campaign, remove Amharic completely and investigate the smaller Acholi, Oromo, Ewe and Luganda issues. Retain the smaller languages when their issue is automatically resolved without weakening a gate; otherwise defer them for later continuous training.
interpretation: Removal is a reversible experiment-scope deferral. No registry entry, manifest, audio object, transcript, prior evidence, model artifact or historical MLflow record is deleted or rewritten.

immutable_scope_evidence.use: scope diagnosis only; no old adapter is authorised for reuse because its training mix contained both deferred languages

acholi.reason: The LR 3e-4 sweep automatically resolves the smaller termination problem without weakening any gate.

oromo.reason: All three corrected sweep configurations terminate fully and improve WER; LR 3e-4 passes.

ewe.reason: Ewe still fails the strict termination gate at LR 3e-4, the only configuration compatible with every other retained validation language. LR 5e-4 fixes Ewe but causes retained Acholi and Fula termination failures.

luganda.reason: All three corrected sweep configurations terminate fully and improve WER; LR 3e-4 passes.

retained_scope_evidence.interpretation: The old LR 3e-4 result proves only that this scope is coherent enough to justify a fresh run. It cannot be selected as the final candidate because it was trained on the superseded 14-language mix.
